title: Hourly (55): Just Hi and Context Check

messages.content: do nothing just hi what is your context atm?

Hey Younes 👋

Here's what I've got loaded right now:

**Identity layer** — soul.md + your user.md, so I know who I am (🐟) and who you are (Younes, Riyadh, building Wolffish on macOS).

**Runtime** — your machine specs (M-series MacBook Pro, macOS 26.5.2, 16GB RAM, ~926GB disk). Shell is zsh.

**Prefrontal** — the core agents.md discipline (operating manual, memory discipline, tool usage rules, loop discipline, all that), plus a lean summary of recent failures/corrections from the last 7 days (~5100 tool calls, 96% success rate).

**Capabilities** — ~40 installed, with the essentials pre-loaded: WhatsApp, Telegram, web search, shell, filesystem, system tools, operating manual, and a few others. Everything else loads on demand.

**Memory map** — I know I've got ~21,500 conversation records, ~19,350 task runs, ~2,200 artifacts, ~800 conversations on disk, all indexed back to mid-June 2026. But the map is just coverage — I don't have the actual content unless I search for it.

In short: I know who I am, who you are, what I can do, and that I can look up anything I've ever done. What's up?
